node.chars: state: SCR-117/default · hc at 640 CSS px

node.name: footer · data
node.chars: Data: seeded synthetic stream (seed 1304, BTCUSDT, tick 0.1); sample data, never a market capture (§0 L61); the tick size is the recorded fixture's

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §0 L67: §11: high contrast at 200 % (640 CSS px), the stacked column, nothing clipped (T AC4)

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Theme: hc (twin of board 01: same frames and words; the hc token set is switched at export)

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Frames (hand-off §H L97): SCR-117/default · hc at 640 CSS px

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: Data: seeded synthetic stream (seed 1304, BTCUSDT, tick 0.1); sample data, never a market capture (§0 L61); the tick size is the recorded fixture's

kids.name: value-6
kids.chars: Markers, tags, fold lines and callouts in color.status.info.default are annotation, not product UI

kids.name: value-7
kids.chars: High-contrast twin of board 01 at the 200 % viewport (§0 L67; twins sentence L61): token-bound, the hc set applied at export

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §11 L256: at 200 % (640 CSS px) the column stacks label, description, control, Effective line, tile; nothing clipped, nothing scrolls horizontally (`05`:131)

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: The stacked page is about 2064 CSS px: 3 strips of 640 x 800 (strip 1 = CSS y 0-800 with the 640 x 400 viewport outlined); vertical scroll only

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: High contrast here is the OS asking for more contrast with the row on "Follow my system": "Effective: On, from your system setting" (§5.1 L163)

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: The focus-ring row adds W-25 "Effective: On, the high-contrast theme" (D04:247): a switch reading Off never hides the thick ring; the focus tile draws the thick ring

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: Control boundaries at border.thick (E47-D03's border.control in hc, FALLBACKS border-control); the tile frames color.border.default

kids.name: value-6
kids.chars: The shell chrome at 640 CSS px is the shell's (A11Y-F-0016 at 320 px, noted, not redesigned): not drawn

W-2 (§15 L285, PROPOSED, the scope line): Scope: per user, for every setting on this page.
W-25 (§15 L308, PROPOSED, the focus-ring row (§5.1)): Effective: On, the high-contrast theme
W-22 (§15 L305, PROPOSED): Show the keyboard shortcut cheatsheet (Ctrl+/)
W-21 (§15 L304, PROPOSED): Read the accessibility statement

the motion tile's accessible name "Motion preview, full motion: the heatmap trail fades, the price flashes": §6 L179 asks for "the configuration in words" and gives no string (an aria-label, not drawn)
"Sample": the focus tile's CMP-001 Button label (§6.2 L185 names the button, not its words)
the focus tile's accessible name "Focus preview: thick ring": §6 L179 asks for "the configuration in words" and gives no string (an aria-label, not drawn)
